I saved a draft email to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and replied to Anselm in his DM to say so. Nothing has been sent; it's in the drafts folder for someone to check and send.

The draft's subject is "Quarrendon Freight Lines – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,356 per seat figure, says the number came from Dana and that Anselm OK'd sharing it, and asks Hollis to keep it to people who need it for the account.

No separate approval request was needed. Hollis wouldn't normally get a pricing figure, but Anselm can approve that and his message did. The address is inside pemberline.com, so Ruth's approval doesn't apply either.
